title: Ep 24 — Cursor learns to build without a GitHub account, and the compliance-paperwork tool with a revenue number that doesn't add up
description: Cursor's Cloud Agents can now build an app from nothing, no repo required, while Google takes speech-to-text and text-to-video tools to general availability and Anthropic teaches Claude to drive lab hardware through one shared spec. Plus a deep dive on Comp AI, a compliance-paperwork generator whose Stripe-linked revenue tracker shows two wildly different numbers, niched for Steve's audience as an instant policy-pack tool for grassroots sports clubs, and the Department for Transport's EV charging-point statistics that finally turned up three days late.
